name.text: Finding area of heptagon given side length and apothem

questiontext.text:
A school garden is in the shape of a regular heptagon. The side length is {@s@} m and the apothem (the distance from the center to the midpoint of a side) is {@a@} m.

[[jsxgraph width="500px" height="300px"]] var s_val = {#s#}; var a_val = {#a#}; var n = 7; var angle = Math.PI / n; // Calculate true geometric radius to maintain perfect shape var R = a_val / Math.cos(angle); // Proportional scaling var ratio = 500 / 300; var spanY = R * 2.5; var spanX = spanY * ratio; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [-spanX/2, spanY/2, spanX/2, -spanY/2], maxboundingbox: [-spanX*1.5, spanY*1.5, spanX*1.5, -spanY*1.5], axis: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true, showNavigation: false }); // Vertices - starting rotation to ensure a flat base at the bottom var points = []; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var theta = -Math.PI/2 - Math.PI/n + (2 * Math.PI * i / n); points.push(board.create('point', [R * Math.cos(theta), R * Math.sin(theta)], {visible: false})); } board.create('polygon', points, { fillColor: '#e3f2fd', strokeColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2 }); var center = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name: '', visible: false}); // Connect center to bottom flat side var pA = points[0]; var pB = points[1]; var mid = board.create('midpoint', [pA, pB], {visible: false}); // Central triangle lines board.create('segment', [center, pA], {strokeColor: '#90caf9', dash: 1}); board.create('segment', [center, pB], {strokeColor: '#90caf9', dash: 1}); // Apothem line board.create('segment', [center, mid], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#c62828'}); // Right angle marker var rad = R * 0.15; board.create('angle', [pB, mid, center], {type: 'square', radius: rad, strokeColor: '#c62828', name: ''}); // Clean horizontal pixel-gap labels var gapY = spanY * 0.04; var gapX = spanX * 0.02; board.create('text', [0, mid.Y() - gapY, s_val + " m"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 16}); board.create('text', [gapX, mid.Y()/2, a_val + " m"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 16, strokeColor: '#c62828'}); [[/jsxgraph]]

Calculate the area of the heptagon garden.

Area = [[input:ans1]] \(\text{m}^2\) [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

(Leave your answer to 2 decimal places)

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

The area (\(A\)) of a regular polygon with \(n\) sides, side length \(s\), and apothem \(a\) is given by the formula:

\[ A = \frac{n}{2} \times s \times a \]

For a heptagon (\(n = 7\)):

\[ \begin{aligned} A &= \frac{7}{2} \times s \times a \\ A &= \frac{7}{2} \times {@s@} \times {@a@} \\ A &= 3.5 \times {@ta_step@} \\ A &= {@ta@} \text{ m}^2 \end{aligned} \]

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text: You multiplied the 7 sides by the base and apothem, but you forgot the \(\frac{1}{2}\) factor for the triangle area.
Almost there! You found the area of exactly one of the central triangles. A heptagon is made of 7 equal triangles, so multiply your answer by 7.
You calculated the perimeter of the heptagon (\(7 \times \text{side}\)). To find the area, you must multiply the perimeter by half of the apothem.
